programme.title: Sankat City
programme.desc: Trouble strikes when Guru and Ganpat, two petty thieves, steal a car belonging to Faujdaar, a gangster, along with the hefty amount of money in the car.

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach
programme.desc: With dreams of becoming a great dancer, Govinda, an ordinary man, is given the opportunity to compete against Rocky, a celebrated dancer, in a twist of fate.

programme.title: Papa Kahte Hain
programme.desc: Sweety runs away from her home to Seychelles in hopes of finding her father. However, things take a turn when she finds out that her father is staying there with another woman.

programme.title: Loha
programme.desc: After a bid to arrest Sher Singh fails, officer Dayal is crippled and his partner Amar's career is sabotaged. When Amar gets another chance to nab Sher Singh, he hires two crooks for the job.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Bahon Mein
programme.desc: Lovers Sagar and Sapna separate due to her father's opposition and meet after many years. However, Sagar reveals that he is to marry Kavita, while Sapna is about to be engaged to Rakesh.

programme.title: Shaandaar
programme.desc: Jagjinder Joginder, a wedding planner, brings together the dysfunctional family of businessman Bipin Arora while making arrangements for his daughter's destination wedding in London.

programme.title: Shaan
programme.desc: After their cop brother dies at the hands of a ruthless gangster, Vijay and Ravi are determined to find the gangster and take their revenge.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Military Raaj
programme.desc: Major Anand is reassigned to a camp for unruly cadets but soon finds himself confronting deeper threats as lawlessness rises and the authorities struggle to maintain order.

programme.title: Sham Ghansham
programme.desc: Satyadev Singh, who leads a happy life with his wife and two sons, is killed by a corrupt collector, Bhim Singh. Years later, his sons, Sham and Ghansham, set out to avenge their father.

programme.title: Hum Pyar Tumhi Se Kar Baithe
programme.desc: Mamta runs away with her son Vishwas to avoid any sort of contact with her criminal husband. Years later, Vishwas is unknowingly employed by his own father.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
programme.desc: When stars misalign, love blossoms between an astrology-obsessed idler and a headstrong fish heiress whose father will settle for nothing less than a hardworking son-in-law.

programme.title: Kal Ki Awaz
programme.desc: When a bank chairman's son is abducted and held for ransom, DSP Ali intervenes but cannot save the child. Later, his world is turned upside down when his daughter is kidnapped.

programme.title: Sansar
programme.desc: After finding out about her pregnancy, Uma decides to go and live with her parents. Upon her return, Uma learns about her broken family and decides to bring them back together.

programme.title: Muqabla
programme.desc: Brothers Suraj and Deepak work for the police as a havildar and a traffic constable respectively. However, they soon turn against each other when Deepak testifies in favour of a criminal.

programme.title: Aitraaz
programme.desc: When a company chairman's trophy wife stirs up a storm in a happily married employee's life, the tumultuous winds drag all of them into an intense courtroom showdown.

programme.title: Gentleman
programme.desc: Kicha is a modern-day Robin Hood, who along with his friend, Mani, steals from the rich to aid the poor. In society, he is a respected man who runs a small business.

programme.title: Khuda Haafiz: 2 - Agni Pariksha
programme.desc: After the death of his friend's brother, Sameer and Nargis adopt his daughter Nandini. However, trouble ensues when she gets kidnapped.

programme.title: Bachchhan Paandey
programme.desc: To succeed in the film industry, Myra chooses Bachchhan Paandey, a notorious hooligan, as the main focus of her new movie. Things get complicated when the gangster decides to act in the film.
